messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: hosted-api US-EAST-1 queue growth detected. p95=1.2s -> 3.8s, p99=2.7s -> 9.6s in 3m. GPU pool utilization 98%. Autoscaler reporting provisioning errors. Paging @ryan-oncall :pager:
ryan-oncall: On it. grabbing dashboards and status. ETA 2m. Who's owning cloud quota checks?
carol-sre: Seeing sustained backlog: queue depth ≈ 18k requests. Many short-lived chat/gen calls. Top path: /v1/generate. Logs show repeated `provisioner.CreateInstance` failures with 429 from cloud API. Paste: `2023-11-08T22:05:11Z provisioner: createInstance failed: rateLimitExceeded`
olivia-eng: Confirmed. autoscaler logs: `scaleUp failed: quotaExceeded` + some `resourceUnavailable` for gpu-type A100-80GB in us-east. Also got transient errors from device-plugin, but those look secondary.
linda-support: Support tickets coming in. Several customers reporting 504s/timeout on generation. One enterprise account reported 30% of calls failing.
alice-pm: What's customer impact across SLAs? Any customers visibly tripping SLO alerts? Need to prep outbound if this is >10min.
ryan-oncall: Quick impact calc: from metrics, ~2% of total requests are erroring, but for some high-throughput tenants it's hitting 10-20%. I'll list top 5 tenants in 2m.
carol-sre: Mitigation options: 1) route lower-priority traffic to cached responses / small-model fallback 2) enable request-throttling for best-effort tiers 3) manual scale by opening a new GPU pool in a different AZ.
olivia-eng: Trying 3 now — but provisioning to a new AZ hitting same quota boundary. Doing 1) first: flip fallback routing for non-SLA routes. Command: `./infractl route set --prefix /v1/generate --policy fallback-smallmodel --filter tier!=enterprise`
ryan-oncall: Executed fallback routing. Pushing a soft throttle for anonymous/free accounts: `./ratectl set /v1/generate anon 0.5rps`
incident-bot: NOTE: fallback routing applied by ryan-oncall @1699501280. Monitoring p99 and queue depth.
carol-sre: After fallback we see queue drop from 18k -> 9k in 2m, p99 -> 5.8s. Good improvement but still high.
olivia-eng: Trying manual provisioning with different GPU SKU (v100-like) as a stopgap. Running `provisioner create --zone us-east-1c --sku V100-32`. If that fails, we'll request emergency quota bump.
infra-ops-bot: Cloud provider response: quota increase request submitted (ticket #CP-48291). ETA unknown.
linda-support: Notifying affected customers in batches. Posting status page note: "Degraded generation performance in US-EAST-1; mitigation in progress."
alice-pm: Good. Prepare a short blurb for customer comms: cause = sudden campaign traffic spike + provisioning quota exhaustion; mitigation = throttling + fallback to smaller model; ETA unknown for full restore.
ryan-oncall: Also enabling aggressive KV caching for repeated prompts: `cachectl promote --route /v1/generate --ttl 60s --prefix-match`
carol-sre: Observability: added temporary alert to auto-escalate if p99 > 10s for 5m. Also collecting a short trace sample for top failing requests.
olivia-eng: Provisioner returned `resourceUnavailable` for V100 in us-east-1c. Trying us-east-1b now. Kickoff command run at 1699501403.
incident-bot: UPDATE: fallback and throttles applied. queue depth 9k -> 6k, p99 -> 3.1s. Autoscaler still failing on some SKUs.
ryan-oncall: We're stabilizing with degraded perf. Support, please continue customer comms. Eng, escalate to cloud ops for quota.
linda-support: Posted update on status page and replied to top affected customers with workaround details and ETA of next update in 20m.
alice-pm: Logging action items: (1) request quota increase (CP-48291) (2) review autoscaler backoff to avoid full stop on transient rate limits (3) retrofit traffic-class isolation so big campaigns don't starve baseline pools.
carol-sre: Will open incident ticket and set severity to SEV2. Collecting final logs for postmortem.
olivia-eng: Provisioning succeeded in us-east-1b at 1699501508 — added 10 GPUs of alternate SKU. Queue draining.
incident-bot: RESOLVED: Manual capacity added + fallbacks kept. p99 down to 1.1s, queue <500. Postmortem channel: #postmortems when we have timeline.
ryan-oncall: Thanks all. Handoff to eng-triage for next steps. I'll add notes to incident doc and start RCA draft.
carol-sre: Quick note: root cause likely multi-tenant campaign spike + rigid autoscaler behavior that collapsed on quota errors instead of gradual fallback.
linda-support: I'll track customer follow-ups and reopen if any regressions.
alice-pm: Great job. We'll review mitigation playbook and prioritize autoscaler resilience in next sprint. :thumbsup:
